scripts.dev: node scripts/with-env.mjs "pnpm --filter @farfield/protocol build && pnpm --filter @farfield/api build && pnpm --parallel --filter @farfield/server --filter @farfield/web dev"
scripts.dev:remote: node scripts/with-env.mjs "pnpm --filter @farfield/protocol build && pnpm --filter @farfield/api build && pnpm --parallel --filter @farfield/server --filter @farfield/web dev:remote"
scripts.e2e:real:install: node scripts/with-env.mjs "pnpm exec playwright install chromium"
scripts.e2e:real:run: node scripts/with-env.mjs "node scripts/validate-e2e-governance.mjs && pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.real.config.ts"
scripts.e2e:real:ui: node scripts/with-env.mjs "node scripts/validate-e2e-governance.mjs && pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.real.config.ts --ui"
scripts.e2e:real:debug: node scripts/with-env.mjs "node scripts/validate-e2e-governance.mjs && pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.real.config.ts --debug"
scripts.verify:real: node scripts/with-env.mjs "node scripts/app-smoke.mjs && node scripts/validate-e2e-governance.mjs && pnpm exec playwright test --config=playwright.real.config.ts"
scripts.premerge:check: pnpm --filter @farfield/protocol build && pnpm --filter @farfield/api build && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm verify:real
